title: Animal groups
_map: Animal groups (Y1). Big idea: mammals, birds, fish, reptiles and amphibians share features. Creative: invent a new animal and decide which group it belongs to, and why.
_story: New animals keep arriving at the farm and the robot needs to know which pen they go in. Ismaeel learns what each group shares, sorts them, then invents a brand new animal.
_stepChain: sorting by properties (secret-sorting-rule) → birds: feathers, lay eggs → fish: fins, live in water → mammals: fur, babies drink milk → reptiles: dry scales → amphibians: start in water, then land → sort the arrivals → invent an animal

talk.ask: Is a dog a mammal? How do you know?
talk.goodAnswer: yes: it has fur and its puppies drink milk.

talk.ask: What group is your invented animal in, and why?
talk.goodAnswer: any group, with a reason from its features.

handsOn: Go on an animal hunt in a book or the garden. For each animal, decide: mammal, bird, fish, reptile or amphibian? Then draw an animal nobody has seen before.

narration.speaker: robot
narration.text: New animals keep arriving at my farm! I need to know which group each one belongs to.
Birds have feathers and wings, and lay eggs. The hen and the duck are birds.
Dogs, cats and rabbits have fur, and their babies drink milk from their mums. Animals like that are called mammals. You're a mammal too!

question.onRight: Yes. It has fins and lives in water, breathing through gills.

0.say: A goldfish has no feathers or wings. It has fins and lives in water, so it's a fish.

2.hint: Does a goldfish have fur? Do its babies drink milk?
2.say: A goldfish has no fur, and its babies hatch from eggs in the water. It has fins: it's a fish.

narration.text: There are two more groups. Reptiles, like lizards and turtles, have dry scaly skin. Amphibians, like frogs, start life in water as tadpoles, then live on land too.

narration.speaker: robot
narration.text: Now invent a brand new animal! Does it have fur, feathers, fins or scales? Does it lay eggs? Then decide which group it belongs to, and tell a grown-up why.

rule.text: Animals in a group share features.
rule.ask: Can you say what makes an animal a mammal? Say it out loud. Then tap the eye.
rule.spoken: Animals in the same group share features. Birds have feathers, fish have fins, and mammals have fur and feed their babies milk.

bonus.prompt: Bonus: a whale lives in the sea. Is it a fish or a mammal?
bonus.reveal: A mammal! Whales breathe air, and their babies drink milk, even though they live in water.
